task: y2i 시그널 소스 확장 — YouTube 의존도 다변화: 한국 증권 뉴스 RSS 인입 파일럿
decision_log: Source ROI ranking: news_rss > podcasts > discussion_boards > twitter_x
Twitter/X: API 비용 prohibitive — out of scope
Podcasts: Whisper 전사 비용 prohibitive (시간당 $)— v2 후보
Discussion boards (Naver/Toss): bot detection + 낮은 S/N — v2 후보
Korean financial news RSS (한경, 머투, 이데일리): 구조화·실시간·무료·기존 LLM extractor 재사용 가능 → 1순위 선정
Dependency policy (CLAUDE.md): stdlib only — feedparser 사용 금지, urllib + xml.etree 로 구현

stories.title: Korean financial news RSS resolver (stdlib)
acceptanceCriteria: New module src/omx_brainstorm/news_source.py with NewsItem dataclass: source_id, outlet, title, summary, url, published_at, raw_categories
NewsResolver.fetch(outlet, max_items) returns list[NewsItem] parsed with stdlib (urllib.request + xml.etree.ElementTree), no new dependency in pyproject.toml
Built-in outlets registry includes at least 3 Korean financial outlets (hankyung, mt, edaily) with their RSS URLs
Published_at returned as ISO-8601 UTC string; empty pubDate handled with current UTC fallback
Network errors raise NewsFetchError with the outlet name and HTTP status (no silent crash)
Optional http_proxy_url / https_proxy_url kwargs mirror youtube.py for outbound network parity
Unit test: parses a fixed RSS XML fixture into NewsItem list — pubDate parse, html-entity-decoded title, missing-fields fallback
Unit test: NewsFetchError raised when urlopen returns non-200 (via mocked urlopen)
All previously-passing tests still pass (.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q)

stories.title: News → SignalRecord pipeline + CLI command
acceptanceCriteria: New helper news_source.classify_news_item(item: NewsItem) -> dict with keys: signal_score, video_signal_class, should_analyze, skip_reason — reusing signal_gate FINANCE_KEYWORDS and ACTIONABLE_TITLE_ANCHORS for Korean tokenisation
Ticker extraction reuses stock_registry.resolve_kr_ticker on NewsItem.title + summary; only .KS / .KQ tickers admitted

New function news_source.ingest_news_into_tracker(db: SignalTrackerDB, items, *, min_signal_score=60.0) writes one SignalRecord per (ticker, outlet, item) with channel_slug='news:<outlet>', verdict='BUY' when score>=68 else 'WATCH', source_video_id=item.source_id (idempotent on re-run)
Idempotency: re-ingesting the same NewsItem list does not add duplicate records (dedup via SignalTrackerDB._record_key)
New CLI command 'ingest-news' in cli.py: omx-brainstorm ingest-news --config config.toml --outlets hankyung,mt,edaily --max-items 30 — exits 0 with JSON summary {ingested, skipped, outlets}
Module-level constant NEWS_HEALTH_PATH = Path('.omx/state/news_ingestion_health.json')
Unit test: classify_news_item flags '삼성전자 HBM 수주' as should_analyze=True with score>=60; flags '먹방 일상' as should_analyze=False
Unit test: ingest_news_into_tracker writes SignalRecord with channel_slug='news:hankyung' and ticker '005930.KS' for a 삼성전자 headline
Unit test: re-ingesting the same NewsItem returns ingested=0 (dedup)

stories.title: Stale-detection healthcheck for news ingestion (74aeb5f pattern)
acceptanceCriteria: ingest-news writes news_ingestion_health.json with last_run_at, last_success_at, last_error_at, status, error_count, ingested_count (same shape as scheduler_health.json)
healthcheck.compute_health_summary works against news_ingestion_health.json with stale_threshold_hours=6 producing is_stale, staleness_hours, healthcheck_at
New CLI command 'news-healthcheck' prints JSON summary and exits 1 when is_stale=True, 0 otherwise
Unit test: simulated healthy state (last_success_at = now) yields is_stale=False
Unit test: simulated stale state (last_success_at = now - 24h) yields is_stale=True and exit code 1
Unit test: missing last_success_at -> is_stale=True (default-skeleton path)

stories.title: Hit-rate + freshness measurement vs YouTube channels
acceptanceCriteria: New script scripts/news_signal_freshness.py compares news SignalRecord set vs YouTube SignalRecord set in .omx/state/signal_tracker.json

Outputs JSON report with: news_tickers_total, news_tickers_unique (not in YT 7d window), overlap_ratio_pct, lead_time_summary (median hours news_signal precedes YT signal for shared tickers), news_hit_rate_5d (when ≥1 mature news SignalRecord)
Script handles empty tracker (no SignalRecords) gracefully — prints zero-counts report and exits 0
Unit test: synthetic mixed tracker (2 news + 3 yt records, 1 shared ticker) produces overlap_ratio_pct=50.0 and unique=1 for news side

stories.title: kindshot_feed integration — export news signals
acceptanceCriteria: export_signals_for_kindshot in kindshot_feed.py treats channel_slug starting with 'news:' as a first-class export candidate (no breakage of YT exports)
News records still must pass _is_exportable_record gates (score>=65, KR market, BUY/STRONG_BUY, conviction or consensus)
kindshot signal output includes 'signal_source' label distinguishing 'y2i:youtube' vs 'y2i:news' (replace flat 'y2i' to label by source class)
Default channel_weight for unknown 'news:*' slugs is 1.0 (preserves baseline export gate)
Unit test: SignalTrackerDB with one YT BUY @ score 75 and one news BUY @ score 75 — both appear in export with correct signal_source labels
Unit test: news WATCH (verdict not in BUY/STRONG_BUY) gets filtered out
All previously-passing kindshot_feed tests still pass
